Package httyd.battle

Class BattleEngine

java.lang.Object
httyd.battle.BattleEngine
public class BattleEngine extends Object
The rules of the game without any user interface. The engine is a state machine: it waits for an action of the side whose turn it is, resolves it and returns the list of events that happened. The GUI only draws those events, and the unit tests run whole battles through it.
